ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (Scrawl.cs:13-16) == cost 1 / SKILL / RARE / SELF. No CanonicalVars -- the draw count is computed.

OnPlay.rationale: `int num = CardPile.MaxCardsInHand - Owner.PlayerCombatState.Hand.Cards.Count; await CardPileCmd.Draw(choiceContext, num, Owner)` (Scrawl.cs:20-21) == `DrawCmd.draw(ctx.player, ctx.player.MAX_HAND_SIZE - len(ctx.player.hand))`. MaxCardsInHand is 10 on both sides (CardPile.cs:21, player.py:56), and Scrawl itself is out of the hand when the count is taken on both sides (Play pile in C#, discard-pile limbo in the sim), so it draws to a FULL hand rather than one short.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `AddKeyword(CardKeyword.Retain)` (Scrawl.cs:26) == `self.retain = True`, and the flag IS re-seeded in `_init_vars` (`self.retain = False`, colorless_skills.py:583), so `downgrade()` restores it -- `py audit/tools/card_probes.py downgrade` does not list scrawl. The correct pattern, unlike card/wish, which gains the same keyword and does not re-seed.
